value.text: Vocational schools can fill teaching gaps and expand class sizes by connecting with qualified retired tradespeople
value.evidence_span: Most schools right now cannot find enough teachers, so they cap their class sizes, and that is where we come in. A retired electrician can teach one evening class a week from our platform, and the school pays us twenty percent of the instructor fee.

premises.text: There is a shortage of electricians and plumbers and vocational schools cannot find enough teachers
premises.evidence_span: There is a shortage of electricians and plumbers and at the same time a lot of very good retired tradespeople who miss working. Our idea is simple. Lathework connects retired tradespeople with vocational schools that need part time instructors. Most schools right now cannot find enough teachers, so they cap their class sizes, and that is where we come in.

premises.text: Retired tradespeople are willing to teach part time if given the opportunity to get paid and pass on their knowledge
premises.evidence_span: We believe retirees will want this because they get paid and because they get to pass on what they know.
